question: Which of the following characteristics will a patient with helminth infection and one who is responding to an allergen have in common ?:

options.opa: In both patients an increase of cytotoxic T lymphocytes will be detected.
options.opb: In both patients the innate immunity will be deficient.
options.opc: In both, an elevated level of serum IgE will be detected.
options.opd: Both patients have a high risk of developing an autoimmune disease.

analysis: Patients with helminth infections and those responding to allergens typically exhibit elevated levels of serum IgE. This is due to the role of IgE in mediating allergic responses and in the immune response to parasitic infections, particularly helminths. The other options do not accurately reflect common characteristics between these two patient groups.
